topVulnerabilities.title: Host Subprocess Sandbox Escape Surface & Unauthenticated Loopback Daemon Trust
topVulnerabilities.details: ProcessSandbox runs host Node child processes with env scrubbing only (no kernel net/fs jail or process-tree kill; now accurately qualified in README/SUBMISSION_PACK); QualityEngineAdapter targets an unauthenticated loopback HTTP daemon; Kali LIVE_CONTAINER retains synthetic placeholder @sha256 digest.
